entries.raw_text: priorities are pressing now - money is being raised to expedite the negotiations and be on the land within 30 days. We are a non-profit association and any donation is tax-exempt. Send any contributions to: Sisters of Diana, Inc., RR1, Box 42A, Tishomingo, OK, 73460. Loan contracts also honored.
entries.notes: Continuation of a listing begun on the previous page; community name left blank, but contributions go to 'Sisters of Diana, Inc.', recorded as contact_name since the community name cannot be filled here (likely the community itself). Type Land Fund/Seeking Land: 'money is being raised to expedite the negotiations and be on the land within 30 days' - not yet on land. num_residents 0 because they are not yet on the land. Land fields copied from the rural route address (RR1) per codebook rule, but since the land is still under negotiation the mailing address may not be the land itself. entries.description: Four lesbian separatists living on 17 secluded acres in northern California with a small cabin, seeking other lesbian separatists to join, build their own sleeping structures and help with land payments; hoping lesbians will buy adjacent land for sale; lesbians passing through welcome to visit.
entries.raw_text: FOUR WOMEN living on 17 secluded acres in northern California are looking for other lesbian separatists to join them. There's a small cabin but women interested in joining them need to build their own sleeping structure and help with land payments. They are hoping that dykes will buy the land adjacent to them that is for sale for $17,000 ($3,400 down). Dykes passing through northern California are welcome to visit. Contact Joanie, 3100 Ridgewood Rd., Willits, CA, 95490 - Phone 707 459-5776.
entries.notes: No formal name; community_name taken from opening words 'FOUR WOMEN'. Type Intentional Community/Cooperative: four women 'living on 17 secluded acres' and recruiting others 'to join them'. num_residents 4 from 'FOUR WOMEN living on'. Lesbian women from 'other lesbian separatists' and 'Dykes passing through... are welcome'; non-lesbian women not coded since welcome words name lesbians. Lesbian separatism focus: 'looking for other lesbian separatists to join them'. Land copied from street address (Ridgewood Rd.), consistent with northern California location.

entries.description: 160 acres southeast of Tucson, Arizona, bought by one woman for use by any interested woman; women and children can rent an A-frame or camp nightly or monthly; seeks financial support, offering a free night of camping for every $2 donated.
entries.raw_text: NOURISHING SPACE FOR WOMEN is located on 160 acres 25 miles southeast of Tucson that a woman has bought to be used by any woman interested. There is space for women and children to rent (there is an A-frame and plenty of land to camp on) on a nightly or monthly basis. They need a lot of financial support so for every $2 a woman donates, she is entitled to one free night of camping available any time in her life. In return for a donation they will send information and directions. Send a stamped, self-addressed envelope to Cave Canyon Ranch, PO Box D-11, Vail, AZ, 85641.
entries.notes: Type Private/Individual Land: 'a woman has bought to be used by any woman interested' (one woman bought and hosts). Mail addressed to 'Cave Canyon Ranch', probably the ranch name of the same land; recorded as contact_name. PO box, so land street/zip left blank; land_state AZ from '25 miles southeast of Tucson'. Lesbian women + Non-lesbian women from 'any woman' and 'space for women and children' (pre-1986 rule). Girl and Boy children from 'children' with no gender given. No residents stated.

entries.description: A group of women squatting on a farm in Ashfield, Massachusetts, resisting eviction and wanting the space for women only; seeking women to stay with them indefinitely and financial support.
entries.raw_text: ASHFIELD FARM WOMEN are "squatting" on a farm in Massachusetts. They have been told to leave but they are hanging on. They want the space for women - no men. They need women to stay with them indefinitely for this action; also financial support. Sorry we don't have all the information about this, but write to the Ashfield Farm Women, Samson Road Farm, Samson Rd., Ashfield, MA 01330.
entries.notes: Type Intentional Community/Cooperative: a group of women already living ('squatting') on the farm and recruiting women 'to stay with them indefinitely'; not a land trust or fund. Mail goes to the community by its own name, so contact_name blank. Land copied from the road address (Samson Rd.), matching 'a farm in Massachusetts'. Lesbian women + Non-lesbian women from 'space for women - no men' (pre-1986 rule); men explicitly excluded. Number of residents not given.

entries.description: A feminist country retreat near Grants Pass, Oregon, run by a collective of five women who open their house for workshops and discussion groups for women; sliding-scale fees, scholarships, negotiable child care, home-cooked food.
entries.raw_text: WOMANSHARE is a feminist country retreat. It is run by a collective of five women who open their house for workshops to women seeking more about themselves and their lives. They say, "we feel that living with each other in the country has helped us to become stronger, healthier, more centered, and more creative. Some of the things we have been dealing with are our feminist politics, our sexuality and our own creativity. We know that we need contact with other women and we also need to find a way to survive economically in the country. Womanshare is our way of doing this." Fees are on a sliding scale from $10 to $15 per day. Scholarships are available and child care is negotiable. Include partial payment $10) when you register. The Womanshare Collective says, "we would like you to come and relax, join in discussion groups and workshops, enjoy good home-cooked food, and get to know us. We feel that being in the country, having a good time with other women can be a very high experience." For more information, write Womanshare, 1531 Gray's Creek Road, Grants Pass, OR, 97526. Thanks to RUNES for this info.
entries.notes: Type Retreat/Gathering Space: 'is a feminist country retreat' (calls itself a retreat even though the collective lives there). num_residents 5 from 'a collective of five women' who live together ('living with each other in the country'). Workshops/education: 'open their house for workshops' and 'join in discussion groups and workshops'. Lesbian women + Non-lesbian women from 'workshops to women' and 'other women' (pre-1986 rule). Girl and Boy children inferred from 'child care is negotiable', implying children may come. Land copied from road address. Printed '$10)' missing opening parenthesis kept as is.

entries.land_location_as_stated: in the rolling Berkshire mountains in Craryville, New York
entries.description: A women's country retreat in the Berkshire mountains at Craryville, New York, with a large A-frame built by women, ten pasture acres for camping and access to wooded acres for hiking; two permanent residents; A-frame rental, camping and work exchanges available.
entries.raw_text: WOMEN'S WAYS RETREAT is a place in the country for women to get in touch with our many ways of doing things. It is a special place where women may come together away from the daily hassles of the patriarchal society and experience the strength of a woman's culture. It is not a resort. Each woman who comes to the land makes a commitment to herself and other women thereby accepting responsibility for herself, as well as by respecting and supporting other sisters who are there. Womens Ways is located in the rolling Berkshire mountains in Craryville, New York. There is a large A-frame house built solely by women. There are ten pasture acres for camping and access to 90 wooded acres for hiking. At present there are two permanent residents. As for accomodations, it is possible to rent the A-frame on a nightly ($3.50 - $5) or monthly ($70.00 plus utilities) basis. Camping is available for $2.50 a night or $40.00 a month and access to the house and utilities is available. Work exchanges are also available, as there is never a lack of projects around. Write or call for reservations or information: Women's Ways, Andrews/Mulholland, RD1, Box 375A, Craryville, NY, 12521.- Phone 518 3[?]5-6612.
entries.notes: Type Retreat/Gathering Space: name and text call it a retreat, 'a place in the country for women'. Acreage 10 from 'ten pasture acres for camping'; the '90 wooded acres' are only 'access to' and are left out. num_residents 2 from 'two permanent residents'. Rural route (RD1) so land copied from mailing address; land_city also stated: 'located in... Craryville, New York'. Lesbian women + Non-lesbian women from 'a place in the country for women' (pre-1986 rule). Contact_name 'Andrews/Mulholland' from mailing line. Middle digit of phone exchange is overtyped and unreadable ('3[?]5'). Stray mark after 'our' ignored.

entries.description: A former mountain resort on 23 acres in the Adirondacks, New York, bought in 1974 by seven women who formed a collective to run a retreat for all women; the collective women and their children live in the main house; four cabins and a recreation facility; sliding-scale rates, groups of up to 30.
entries.raw_text: A WOMAN'S PLACE began in September, 1974 when seven women pooled their resources, purchased a former mountain resort, and established a woman's collective dedicated to the support of a retreat for all women. Women are welcome to come for a day, a week, or a month, and A Woman's Place can also be reserved for groups of up to 30 women. A Woman's Place is situated on 23 acres in the Adirondacks; there is a main house where the collective women and their children live, four large nearby cabins and a recreation facility. The rates are on a sliding scale of $10 to $25 a day. Due to reservation demands, A Woman's Place needs a definite commitment on specific dates. Along with your reservations, please send a small deposit. Write to Mary Deyoe, A Woman's Place, Athol, NY, 12810 - Phone 518 623-9541.
entries.notes: Type Retreat/Gathering Space: the collective is 'dedicated to the support of a retreat for all women' and the place is defined by visitors and group reservations. Seven founding women are not counted as current residents; the number of collective women and children living there is not given, so num_residents blank. Lesbian women + Non-lesbian women from 'a retreat for all women' (pre-1986 rule); Girl and Boy children from 'the collective women and their children live' (children of members, gender not given). Mailing address has no street or box; land_state NY from mailing state and 'in the Adirondacks'; land city not stated so left blank.

entries.land_location_as_stated: the Elwha River running through the back meadow
entries.description: 78 acres in Washington with trees, hay, animals and the Elwha River, owned by the gay community of Seattle; two lesbians live in a tipi and three gay men in the front houses; open to lesbians and gay men, with more lesbians wanted for country living or passing through.
entries.raw_text: DEAREST WOMYN: For lesbians who are interested in country living, or passing thru and need a mellow atmosphere to stay in. We live in a 18' tipi on 78 acres with trees, hay, animals and the Elwha River running through the back meadow. The property is owned by the gay community of Seattle and presently has 3 faggots living in the up front houses, and we are back near the forest land. The land is for lesbians and faggots, however more lesbians would be nice and the men here would rather turn the total 78 over to the dykes. --KD & Barb Aehle - Rt. 3, Box 1708, Port Angles, WA, 98362 - PH. 206 452-2435
entries.notes: 'DEAREST WOMYN:' is a salutation, not a name; community_name taken from the place feature named ('Elwha River'). Contact_name from signature 'KD & Barb Aehle'. City printed 'Port Angles' kept as printed. Rural route (Rt. 3) so land copied from mailing address. Type Intentional Community/Cooperative: land 'owned by the gay community of Seattle' (not stated to be a land trust), with two women in the tipi plus '3 faggots living in the up front houses', and recruiting 'lesbians who are interested in country living'; not two-woman private land since it is community-owned with five residents. num_residents 5 = 2 women ('We live in a 18' tipi') + 3 gay men, counted as part of the land community ('The land is for lesbians and faggots'). Accepted: Lesbian women and Gay men from 'The land is for lesbians and faggots'.
